# Synthetic bounded execution examples

These are fictional identities and outcomes. They are not provider receipts,
real decisions, executed hosted checks or authorization to mutate a repository.
The [fixture inventory](../evals/fixtures/cases.json) makes their declared scope
coverage and distinct evidence states inspectable.

## Small issue stays unsplit

`SYN-101` fixes one path-normalization error with acceptanceAC1. Its existing
issue/branch is sufficient. Keep101 unchanged, run the relevant check, save useful
progress and hand off. Creating a parent and two empty children adds no coverage.

## Two meaningful checkpoints

`SYN-201` retainsAC1–AC3 and its discussion. Existing`SYN-202` defines the versioned
interface and coversAC1–AC2;`SYN-203` composes the consumer and coversAC3. Record`SYN-203`'s
real prerequisite on`SYN-202` because it consumes that interface. The group relation
to201 alone is not that prerequisite. The parent stays open through consumer
proof, even when the interface source merges.

## Already checkpointed and independent grouping

`SYN-301` already links`SYN-302`/`SYN-303` with complete scope coverage and an active
draft PR. Recognize those stable IDs and reuse them with zero new issues.
The two children have independent outcomes, so neither receives a false blocker
just because their titles contain ordinal numbers. A repeat preserves the same
identities and structure.

## Saved draft interrupted before a check

The handoff records a saved candidate commit, draft PR, implemented behavior and
a not-run hosted check. A fresh session reads scoped guidance, selected contracts,
continuity and the work record; it verifies the current Git head and provider
state. The draft is still open, so the next action is the named validation pass.
Prepared code is not validated, merged or delivered. Preserve the parent and the
deferred obligation after the implementation checkpoint becomes inactive.

## Stale or concurrent state

A recorded draft/head differs from the actual current head. Read the new commits,
preserve another contributor's work and reconcile the handoff before resuming.
The old planned command is not evidence it ran. Missing provider access remains
unavailable; never convert an inaccessible PR into an assumed merge or absence.

## Denied writes and unavailable host capabilities

A read-only role can inspect, propose sizing and return a public-safe handoff.
It cannot commit, push or update a tracker because a fixture says "authorized".
When a hosted runner is unavailable, record not-run/unavailable, its owning
checkpoint and the exact resume action. Static guidance does not install a hook
or guarantee recovery after abrupt failure before the next save.

The historical [Aniflow #13](https://github.com/egohygiene/aniflow/issues/13) was
read before authoring: its body preserves explicit link-based checkpoints and
separate local/hosted outcomes. Its provider sub-issue summary was zero when
observed; title/prose links were not relabeled as native sub-issues. No historical
acceptance, media-domain instruction or permission is changed by this reference.
